evidence.limits: No transcript yet; speech is coded from burned-in captions (4 fps to 5 s, 1 fps afterwards, so words between seconds are missed). The captions are keyed numbers and short phrases only, so what each member actually says is not established beyond the figures. Money figures are the club's own on-screen captions, not verified. Matan does not appear. Sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Montage of eight members of his entrepreneurs' club (מועדון היזמים) on stage, each stating last month's income against this month's (for example 0 to 9,370, 94,000 to 295,000); ends on the club logo with 'כי 1000 יזמים לא טועים!'.
audience: Aspiring and small-business entrepreneurs who might join the club; existing members.
caption_vs_video_note: Matches: the caption says that every month the club brings entrepreneurs who made a big jump in money on stage, and points to the link in the bio. The caption tells viewers to click the link; the video has no link or CTA of its own.

opening.first_frame: A man in a black shirt holding a microphone in front of a brown photo wall covered in the gold diamond 'מועדון היזמים' logo; green caption 'סגרתי עסקאות בסך 140,000' and a gold name plate 'טל איבנשוט / מלווה משקיעים בנדל"ן'.
opening.s0_1: Same shot; the caption is a green line with a number from the first frame; he speaks to camera.
opening.s1_3: He smiles slightly, gestures at his waist; the caption stays.
opening.s3_5: At 3.25 s cut to a woman on the same backdrop with a yellow caption 'והחודש?' then green 'עשיתי 7,700' (from 4.0 s); her plate reads 'טל ותורי / מלווה בעלי עסקים לעמידה מול מצלמה'.
opening.visual_hook: A speaker with a mic against a gold logo wall and a big green number already on screen.
opening.spoken_hook: Machine transcript is poor: 0-5 s reads roughly 'closed deals 140 [thousand?]... this month I made 7,700' (the '140,000' vs '140' is unclear); numbers match the captions
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: the caption names a result ('closed deals worth 140,000') without needing context
opening.works_without_sound: yes: numbers and name plates carry the message.

visual.subject_placement: One speaker centred per shot, standing in front of the repeated logo wall; the caption sits across the waist (about 60-65 percent) and the gold name plate at the bottom (about 80-90 percent).
visual.setting: A press-style backdrop with the club's gold diamond logo; an event space (inferred from audio-less framing and the microphones).
visual.lighting: Even warm soft light on the speakers.
visual.color_contrast: Dark brown and gold background, neon green and red captions, gold name plates.
visual.props_and_gestures: Handheld microphones; hand gestures; one speaker points aside at 25 s; the final woman, a pair of two women (26-29 s).
visual.supporting_footage: End card collage of event photos behind the club logo (44-49 s).
visual.persistent_branding: The club's gold logo is tiled across the whole backdrop in every speaker shot; the name plates are on every speaker.
visual.faces_blurred: no (members are identified by name and job)
visual.visual_progression: 0-3.25 first speaker (real estate lender); 3.25-6 woman (business owner coach); 6-9 man in a black vest (kosher supervisor); 9-12 woman (car mechanic adviser); 12-16 woman with glasses (Instagram leads); 16-23 man in striped shirt (cannabis start-up helper); 23-26 woman in yellow (postpartum doula); 26-30 two women (bar cocktails); 30-33 man in a beige shirt (web school); 33-36 woman in denim shirt (marathon coach); 36-43 man in a black T-shirt (contractor); 44-49 club logo end card over an event photo collage.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is the 33-35 s woman with the caption 'חודש אחרון על 54,700'.
visual.ui_interference: The captions sit at about 60-65 percent and the name plates at about 80-90 percent, inside the bottom 35 percent.

editing.edit_function: A hard cut to a new member about every 3 to 7 s; each gets a name plate and an 'before' (red) and 'after' (green) figure, so the structure of the Reel repeats with a rising list of stories. The end card (44 s) shifts from proof to brand.
pacing_changes: t=0-9 s: three speakers in 9 s (fastest)
t=16-23 s: one speaker held 7 s
t=36-43 s: the biggest figure, held 7 s with a longer pause
t=44-49 s: logo reveal and collage
editing.ending: Club logo on a black gold-dust screen (44 s), then a photo collage with the text 'כי 1000 יזמים לא טועים!'.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: low; the point is the ascending list of numbers, which is quickly consumed.

sound.delivery: Level mostly -14 to -20 dB with short dips near the cuts; the machine transcript has short number phrases about every 2-3 s until 28 s, then a repeated '0 שקלים וחודש' loop from 28 s to 50 s (transcript unclear after 28 s, likely a Whisper repetition, not speech).
sound.sync: Each speaker's caption switches at the cut to the next member; the numbers appear in red and green captions about 3 s after each plate.

text.colour_coding: Red for the earlier month ('חודש שעבר 30,000', 'חודש קודם 0'), green for the new, higher figure ('ועכשיו 52,000', 'החודש הזה 295,000'), yellow for question prompts ('והחודש?', 'חודש שעבר?').
text.placement: Across the speaker's waist at about 60-65 percent, over the name plate area at about 80-90 percent.
text.style: Heavy rounded sans-serif with a black outline; name plates are gold boxes with black text, a bold name and a smaller job line.
text.density_and_read_time: 1 to 4 words per card with one number; each number is on screen 3 to 7 s; about 45 words over 49 s.
text.language: Spare, numeric and impersonal: 'סגרתי עסקאות בסך', 'חודש שעבר', 'החודש הזה'; the closing 'כי 1000 יזמים לא טועים!' is a slogan.
text.caption_structure: A pointer to the bio link, then two long sentences about the monthly stage event for the club and the club's info being in the bio; a money emoji; no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew with numerals and the comma thousands separator, sometimes with the number preceded by a Hebrew word; 'ל-6,860' shows the prefix hyphen with the numeral correctly.

story.setup: Members of the club each state their income now and before.
story.progression: Eight members with increasing numbers (7,700 to 295,000), each with a job.
story.payoff: The highest figure (295,000 in the month versus 94,000 earlier) and the club's brand end card.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the figures are stated but no method, cause or 'how' is shown
friction_points: t=0-44 s: several members repeat the same format (interpretation: monotone)
t=26-29 s: two speakers share a frame and the captions show only one number (interpretation: unclear)

explicit_prompts.wording: לפרטים נוספים לחצו על הלינק בביו

engagement.comment_notes: Only 8 sampled comments (the Reel has 27), not representative. One doubts the figures ('אפילו לא נשמע הגיוני', 11 likes), one jokes 'אני עשיתי החודש 2 מיליון' (15 likes), one asks 'everyone has a digital course?'. The likes per 1k views (2.9) are the lowest in my set.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Short, plus one reply 'לרובם אין' and emoji.

conversion.cta_timing: caption only (the video carries only the club logo and slogan at 44-49 s)
conversion.benefit: Income growth in a short time, from the on-screen figures.
conversion.proof: Eight members with name, job and before-and-after income (self-reported on screen).
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Caption: link in bio of his page; no link visible in the video.
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: member testimonies promote the club.
conversion.destination: Link in bio (not visible); the club's page.

rights_and_privacy: Own event footage of named members and their incomes; identifiable adults on a branded backdrop, shown with a name and job (consent not verified). Not reusable as a template without permission; a competition for his members' data is involved.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a clear repeatable structure with figures in the first frame, social proof from varied ordinary jobs, and the logo wall in every shot that brands the club without a pitch.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: it is a promo with a long list of unverified numbers; the lowest likes per 1k (2.9) and comments (0.14) in my set suggest less appeal than his message Reels; some viewers doubt the claims.

standout_moments.what: A number ('140,000') on screen in the first frame, over the branded wall.
Red 94,000 turns to green 295,000, the biggest before/after jump in the list.
Logo reveal with 'כי 1000 יזמים לא טועים!', the brand close.
